entries.text:
God Didn't Arrange a Marriage — He Courted a Bride

I sat down to study the first coming of Christ, and the Holy Spirit took me somewhere I wasn't planning to go.

Here's what hit me. If God had made it impossible for us to turn away, He'd have made puppets, not sons. He wanted us to choose Him the way He chose us. A world redeemed by the blood of His Son shows more of His glory and love than a world that never fell — grace shown is greater than innocence protected. You'd never know the depth of His love if it cost Him nothing.

The picture that made it click for me: God didn't arrange a marriage — He courted a bride. The church is the Bride of Christ (Ephesians 5). It's exactly like Kimberly and me. I saw her, I fell in love with her, I chose her — and she chose me back. That mutual choosing is what makes it love. It's not a forced partnership where someone says "you will be my wife." God showed us what He'd do — He went to the cross — and then He said, "now, will you have Me?" He wanted a bride who would say yes.

Thank You, Holy Spirit, for feeding me this. I came to study the first coming, and the living Christ revealed Himself to me in it. This is something I want to share in one of my first vlogs.
